newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka dissolves foreign investment board.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka dissolves foreign investment board.

text.p: Sri Lankan President Chandrika Kumaratunga has dissolved the board of directors of the Board of Investment (BOI), the main government agency for foreign investment, board members said on Tuesday.
"The BOI is going to be reconstituted, but with no change in the post of chairman," said Thilan Wijesinghe, chairman of the BOI. "I have had specific instructions to stay put."
Board member Patrick Amerasinghe told Reuters a senior official from the president's office contacted him on Monday evening, requesting him to submit his resignation.
Government sources, who wished to remain unidentified, said the move may have been prompted by a long-felt need by the government to strengthen the BOI by injecting it with fresh talent.
The BOI, which is responsible for mobilising foreign investment in the Indian Ocean island, is governed by a five member board and functions directly under the president.
